summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the technical challenge of updating system timezones, specifically needing two zones for Kyiv in ClickHouse. [p1] noted that browser names are changing and the underlying system needs to be updated accordingly.

[p3] suggested using `sudo apt install tzdata` on Ubuntu. It was confirmed that changes cannot be applied directly to production without Ansible automation.

It was observed that while ClickHouse only lists `Europe/Kiev`, other zones like `Europe/Kyiv` are available locally, leading to confusion regarding the correct and current timezone naming conventions.
decisions: The system needs an update mechanism (like Ansible) to handle timezone changes on production servers.
